## MactsError class

Base of every structured macts failure.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare abstract class MactsError<C extends ErrorCode = ErrorCode> extends Error
```

**Extends:** Error

## Remarks

`code` identifies the failure category and narrows `details` when switching over [AnyMactsError](./contracts.anymactserror.md)<!-- -->. `cause` is retained locally for diagnosis and is never serialized.
